div.span: Pipeline D: Cyber-Physical Lab Report Audit & Swap Detection
Pipeline C: Agronomic Crop Suitability Advisory
Pipeline B: Optical Soil Carbon & Nitrogen Estimation
Pipeline A: Leaf Disease Classification & Abstention Triage

Update Tab 1:
Disease Status Chip, Confidence Bar, Treatment Info

Update Tab 2:
CIELAB Swatches, OC/N/Ctot Bars with 90% Ranges, Warnings

Update Tab 3:
Suitability Score Bars, Limiting Factor Badges, Advisory Warning

Update Tab 4:
Batch Rank Grid, Swap Partner Diagram, Correction Preview
Render Error Banner in Current Tab
Execute Pipeline B Color Extraction on Soil Photo

Compute Per-Property Standardized Z-Scores:
z_k = (z_reported - mu_predicted) / sigma

Classify Marginal Consistency:
|z| < 1.645: Consistent | 1.645-2.576: Unusual | > 2.576: Suspicious
Insert Report into Reference Batch of 11 Real KSSL Soils (n=12)

Construct Hypothesis Space:
• S_tray (281 Permutations)
• C (Decimal, Unit, Digit Swap, ColSwap, Gross)

Bayesian Batch Inference Engine (inference.py)
Compute Likelihood Tensor ell(j, i)
Evaluate Marginal Swap Posterior P(moved)
Evaluate Marginal Value Posterior P(val_err)
Rank Batch Reports by Error Score: 1 - P(clean)
Target Report Ranked in Top Suspicious?
MAP Attribution: Identify Swapped Partner Vial
MAP Attribution: Identify Corrupted Property & Inverse Op
Pass Through Split-Conformal p-Value & BH Gate (q=0.10)
Assemble Audit Report: Rank, Explanation, Recommended Fix
Load 25 Crop Limits & Validated Local Overrides

Generate 5 Scenarios Across pH 5.0 - 8.5
(Multi-Soil Uncertainty Propagation)

Evaluate Trapezoidal Scores: pH, Rain, Temp, Texture
Apply Liebig's Law of the Minimum: S = min(Factors)

Compute Weighted Mean Score & Worst-Case Scenario
Sort Crops Descending by Suitability
Return Error: Selected Area Too Small

Sample 24 Chart Patch Medians
Fit Degree-2 Root-Poly CCM Matrix

Compute True CIELAB (L*, a*, b*)
Status: Calibrated & Reliable

Crop Central 50% Soil Area
Convert Uncorrected Linear RGB to CIELAB
Status: Uncalibrated (Heuristic)
Append Warning: Dark/Moist Soil May Overestimate SOC
Append Warning: Color Out of Distribution

Flag as 'Not Sure' (Abstention Gate)
Advise Retake or Expert Consultation
Upload Soil Photo + Enter Lab Test Values
